code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5,4))
ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
# rigid core
import matplotlib.patches as patches
core = patches.Rectangle((1,0.5), 4, 1.2, fill=True, color='lightgray', label='core')
ax.add_patch(core)
ax.text(3, 1.1, 'rigid core', ha='center', fontsize=8)
# PCB
ax.plot([1,5],[1.7,1.7], linewidth=4, color='green')
ax.text(3,1.85,'PCB electrodes', ha='center', fontsize=8)
# pillars
for x in [1.5,2.5,3.5,4.5]:
    ax.add_patch(patches.Rectangle((x-0.15,1.9),0.3,0.8, fill=True, color='pink'))
ax.text(4.8,2.3,'pillars', fontsize=8)
# outer skin dome
import numpy as np
th=np.linspace(0,180,100)*np.pi/180
R=2.6; cx=3; y0=2.7
ax.plot(cx+R*np.cos(th), y0+R*np.sin(th)*0.9, color='black', linewidth=2)
ax.text(3,5.2,'ridged skin 1.5-3mm', ha='center', fontsize=8)
ax.text(3,0.2,'finger mount (fixed)', ha='center', fontsize=8)
ax.arrow(3,5.8,0,-0.5, head_width=0.15, length_includes_head=True)
ax.text(3.3,5.7,'contact load', fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('sketch.png', dpi=150)
